name: DeleteFaceVerifyResult

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier for ID Verification
parameters.name: certify_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the deletion relies on the data retrieved from the corresponding verification process. Valid values:
Y: Yes. To successfully delete the related data, you must have obtained the processing result by calling the DescribeFaceVerify operation.
N: No. This is the default value. You can directly set this parameter to N when you use the server-only API integration mode
parameters.help_zh:
删除时是否依赖已获取到对应认证流程中的相关数据。

Y：需要。如果需成功删除相关数据，必须已通过DescribeFaceVerify接口获取处理结果。
N：不需要（默认）。通过纯服务端API集成模式时可直接传入N
parameters.name: delete_after_query

Code.description_en: The return code. A value of 200 indicates success, and other values indicate failure
Code.description_zh: 返回码：200为成功，其他为失败

CertifyId.description_en: The unique identifier for ID Verification

DeleteResult.description_en:
The deletion result. Valid values:
Y: The deletion succeeded.
N: The deletion failed
DeleteResult.description_zh:
删除结果。取值如下：

Y：删除成功。
N：删除失败

FailReason.description_en:
The reason for the deletion failure. Valid values:
NOT_DELETE_REPEATEDLY: The data cannot be repeatedly deleted.
NEED_QUERY_VERIFY_RESULT: You must query the verification result before you delete the data
FailReason.description_zh:
删除失败原因

NOT_DELETE_REPEATEDLY：不能重复删除
NEED_QUERY_VERIFY_RESULT：需要先查询认证结果，再删除
